name: Modern IAF
title: Modern IAF setup

disk_note: Sentinel-2 only / with the Survey of Israel
free_online: Too little disk space for every Sentinel-2 tile: about %s of them are read online during the build.
free_low: Free disk space: %s. The build needs about %s.
hint_linux: Install it: sudo apt install gdal-bin curl (Arch: sudo pacman -S gdal curl), then start setup again.
hint_mac: Install it: brew install gdal curl, then start setup again.
hint_windows: Install it: winget install GISInternals.GDAL, then start setup again.
s2_note: 8 m over Israel, 32 m beyond. About %s on disk, about %s.
survey: Sentinel-2, plus the Survey of Israel 2 m photo over Israel
survey_note: %d sheets found. About %s on disk, about %s.
survey_needs: Needs the Survey of Israel 2015 sheet ZIPs (data.gov.il, 79 sheets, 17 GB) in %s.
for_osm: airbases, runways, the coast, inland water, buildings and roads
for_f16: the F-16 models and the 3D cockpit
for_textures: the ground, model and tree textures
stopped: Setup stopped: %s. The log has the details (%s). Press Install again: the finished steps are kept.
finished: Done: %d steps ran, %d were up to date.
finished_skipped: Done: %d steps ran, %d were up to date, %d skipped: the reason is under the step, and Retry runs it again.
include: Include this step; untick it to leave it out (nothing downloaded or built)
why_gdal: GDAL is needed (gdalwarp, ogr2ogr): install it, then press Retry.
why_offline: The sources cannot be reached (offline?): press Retry when online.
why_incomplete: Built, incomplete: %d sources could not be downloaded, so their areas are left out. Retry fetches only them.
remove_q: "%s" is left out. Remove the data it built? This frees %s. The sim flies without it; ticking the step again builds it anew.
remove_downloads: Also its downloads in assets/source (%s more; ticking the step again downloads them anew)
remove_shared: The downloads stay: another setup in this assets folder uses them
remove_kept: "%s" is left out. Its data stays, because another setup in this assets folder uses it.
